newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee stable vs dollar, weaker vs stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee stable vs dollar, weaker vs stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was unchanged against the dollar but weaker against sterling on Tuesday, forex dealers at commercial banks said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 20.0035 to the dollar, unchanged from Monday. Against sterling, the rupee weakened to a mean rate of 33.0955, from 32.8965 on Monday.

Forex dealers said the central bank intervened in the interbank forex market around lunchtime on Monday to support the local currency but this was offset by a stronger dollar in overnight international markets.

"During the intervention, the central bank sold dollars slightly below the prevailing interbank rate. This was meant to support the rupee but the intended effect was offset by the stronger dollar overseas," one dealer said.
Forex demand from bank clients is now subdued as importers have already replenished their stocks for the end-of-year festivities, the banker added.
